{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
response_fraction = treatment_df['responded'].mean()

print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(treatment_df)}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_df['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Response fraction: {response_fraction}")"}
